create_poll_based_barrier: create a PollBasedBarrier instance for distributed rank synchronization with an optional noop mode
mark_local_arrive: mark the current rank as locally arrived at the barrier point
poll_global_arrived: poll whether all distributed ranks have arrived at the barrier using all_reduce MIN
compute_global_arrived: compute global arrival status by reducing local arrived flags across all ranks via torch.distributed.all_reduce
setup_distributed_barrier: setup a distributed barrier that blocks until all ranks call local_arrive and confirm global arrival
